messages:
emma_ng: kicking off a thread to capture the GPTQ bakeoff + deployment profiling notes. models tested: Llama-2-13b, Mistral-7b-v0, Qwen-7b. quant modes: GPTQ-4, AWQ-4, FP8, INT8. objective: accuracy deltas + latency/memory tradeoffs and recommended rollout profiles. results uploaded to s3 but posting highlights here.

raj_patel: quick highlights — Mistral-7b with GPTQ-4 shows ~1.6% absolute drop on NQ accuracy, p50 latency +9ms, p95 +12ms vs FP16 on A100. GPU mem down ~28%. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

sasha_ml: Llama-2-13b + GPTQ-4 exhibits KV-cache degradation once ctx >= 8k in our spike test. tokens after warmup start drifting (more repetition). suspect KV quant overflow/precision. Need KV warmup replay to confirm. :eyes:

mike_h: Qwen-7b AWQ-4 looks promising — p50 perf improves ~25%, p95 ~18% improvement, EM regressions <0.5% on our QA suite. FP8 on Qwen had some hallucination increases on instruction tasks.

emma_ng: can folks paste the exact eval commands and the p50/p95 + gpu mem numbers so I can drop into the summary for eng-runtime? also call out which kernel backends were used (native kernels vs triton/custom).

raj_patel: paste of eval command we used for mistral (same pattern for others):
```bash
./run_eval.sh \
  --model /mnt/models/mistral-7b/gptq-4/ \
  --quant gptq \
  --dataset natural_questions \
  --ctx 2048 \
  --batch 8 \
  --out s3://redwood-evals/gptq-bake/1738456789/mistral/
```
metrics: p50=98ms, p95=220ms, gpu_mem=9.6GB (A100-80). kernels: custom fused attention + pytorch-cuda kernels (non-trt).

ci-bot: results uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/gptq-bake/1738456789/ (csvs + per-run traces).

sasha_ml: more notes: FP8 was numerically stable for Llama variants on closed-book QA but caused hallucination spikes on generative instruction evals for Qwen. GPTQ seems to hurt long-context behavior on Llama unless we do KV warmup; AWQ is generally the best throughput/quality balance for Mistral. Also quant-aware LoRA saved ~0.6% acc for Llama when applied post-quant.

mike_h: deployment profile recs (draft):
- Mistral-7b: AWQ-4 default for hosted API; canary 5% then 30% ramp.
- Llama-2-13b: GPTQ-4 only after KV warmup fix; otherwise keep FP16 or AWQ fallback. Canary 2% then 20%.
- Qwen-7b: keep FP16 for mission-critical flows until we finish FP8 hallucination ablation; AWQ for batch workloads.

emma_ng: action items (short):
1) rerun Llama GPTQ long-ctx with KV warmup replay (who: @sasha_ml)
2) Qwen FP8 hallucination ablation + small instruction eval (who: @sasha_ml)
3) rollout YAML + fallback policy draft (who: @raj_patel)
4) perf SLO targets and cost delta calc vs FP16 (who: @mike_h)

sasha_ml: taking items 1 & 2. ETA: EOD for initial runs, will upload traces.

raj_patel: I'll author the rollout YAML and include an automated fallback to FP16 if exact-match drops >1.0% or p95 increases >15%. will attach sample snippet to PR.

mike_h: adding perf SLOs: target p95 < 220ms for 13b baseline (FP16 baseline). cost target: per-token compute -~30% vs FP16 for AWQ/GPTQ on 7b/13b ranges.

emma_ng: perfect. once we have re-run numbers, I'll compile a short blurb for eng-runtime + product ops with recommended defaults and canary policies. :memo:

deploy-bot: Canary job created: gptq-mistral-awq-1738456789 — status queued.

sasha_ml: uploaded KV warmup traces to s3://redwood-evals/gptq-bake/1738456789/llama/kv-warmup.tar.gz — initial look: warmup reduces drift but needs a micro-adjust to warmup length (512->1024 tokens).

emma_ng: thanks all — we'll reconvene after uploads. dropping a short executive summary once the final CSVs are in. :rocket:
